text:
mike: FYI planning to push console-ui v2.3.1 today during the CDN window at 18:30 UTC (frontier window). Who's available to run the deploy and own smoke checks? I'd like a quick rollback plan in place.

sara: I can run the deploy. I'll be at my desk from 18:15. Do we want canary 10% first?

oliver: +1 for 10% canary. Also pre-warm edges for the new assets to avoid 504s.

mike: @sara please follow the standard release doc but add an edge-warm step. Can you invalidate the paths after we confirm canary? steps:
- prime edges with curl to edge host
- deploy canary (10%)
- smoke (health + api + ui assets)
- global invalidation if canary looks good

sara: copy. smoke commands I'll run:
```
curl -fsS https://console.redwood.test/healthz
curl -fsS https://console.redwood.test/ping?version=2.3.1
# head request to important asset
curl -I https://d123.edge.cloudfront.net/assets/console/v2.3.1/main.js
```

lisa: I'll be oncall and watching infra metrics. If anything spikes, tag me @lisa. Also keep the rollback tag handy: `feature.console_v2` toggle.

mike: rollback plan: flip `feature.console_v2` -> off, and if we need full rollback before toggle takes effect, redeploy previous commit to canary slot. SRE can revert infra routing if necessary.

sara: cloudfront invalidation I'll run after canary. Suggest path: `/assets/console/v2.3.1/*` — will create a staged invalidation (regions in 3 batches) to avoid edge thundering.

oliver: for warm-up, I'll run a small script hitting top assets from 10 edge IPs. sending it 5m before deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sara for 2287655400 (18:30:00 UTC) — canary=10% -> monitor window 10m -> roll to 100% on success. :rocket:

sara: on it. I'll post smoke results in this thread when done. ping me if you need me to hold the deploy.

mike: thanks. target timeline:
- 18:15 edge warm-up
- 18:30 start canary
- 18:40 smoke pass -> begin staged invalidation
- 18:50 start 100% rollout
- 19:00 final smoke and metrics check

oliver: noted. I'll run the perf quick checks and hit the console dashboard after canary.

lisa: I'll watch error budget and latency. If 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency +30% from baseline -> call rollback.

sara: smoke pass ✅ (health OK, ping returns 200, asset HEAD returns 200). Starting staged invalidation now. I'll paste invalidation IDs after.

sara: invalidation created: ID inval-abc12345 (batch 1/3). I'll wait 2m between batches.

mike: awesome. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup: 

sara: batch 2/3 done, inval-def67890

oliver: perf checks look normal. p95 is within +8%.

sara: batch 3/3 done, inval-ghi24680. Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Status: rollout -> 100% complete at 2287655780. Monitoring window active.

lisa: metrics stable. No substantial error spikes. Green from infra side.

mike: great work team. I'll close the rollout doc and tag release. :tada:
